sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 1066 of 2019
Applicant :- Mandeep Bhola

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Anr
Counsel for Applicant :- Keshari Nandan Singh,Satyendra Narayan Singh,Tapan Kumar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Katyayini Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for opposite party nos. 1 and 2 and perused the record.

In compliance of the Court' order dated 04.01.2023, trial court has transmitted photo copy of the compliance report, photo copy of the compromise deed executed between the parties and photo copy of the verification order dated 24.01.2023 passed thereon., whereby parties are said to have arrived at a compromise, and no dispute remains among them.
The dispute is matrimonial, hence the compromise between the parties would not affect the society adversely.
As some of the sections involved are non compoundable, hence as per direction of this Court, the trial court has verified the compromise between the parties and same is transmitted to this Court.
As the compromise between the parties has been verified by the trial court, so the compromise and verification order dated 24.01.2023 passed thereon are accepted.
Both these documents shall form a part of the order.

As the compromise deed of the parties has been verified by the trial court and the same is accepted by this Court, hence, the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 03 of 2013, State of U.P. Versus Mandeep Bhola vs State Of U.P. And Anr on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102374914/
1 Mandeep Bhola, under Sections 498A, 323 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Ghaziabad arising out of Case Crime No. 06 of 2012, under section 498A, 323 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Ghaziabad are hereby quashed.
The application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is, thus, allowed.
Order Date :- 18.4.2023
